title: Bathroom Waterproofing quote, real prices, under a minute
jobDescription: Waterproofing for a new main bathroom, dimensions three metres by two point five metres, located on the first floor of a residential build. Scope includes full floor waterproofing, shower recess waterproofing (one point two metres by zero point nine metres) extending up one point eight metres high on three walls, and perimeter wall waterproofing to one hundred and fifty millimetres high for the remainder of the bathroom. This job involves surface preparation, application of a compliant two-part flexible liquid waterproofing membrane system in two coats, installation of reinforcing tape to all internal corners and floor-to-wall junctions, and bond breaker tape. Includes supply and installation of an eighty millimetre hob formwork for the shower base. A waterproofing certificate compliant with AS3740 will be issued upon completion.
workingDetail: Liquid waterproofing membrane, Reinforcing tape (corners and joints), Bond breaker tape, Primer / sealer
